message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "R&D Intensity Change", "construction": "Change in R&D expenditure over the past year, scaled by beginning-of-year total assets. Data from Compustat: (R&D_t - R&D_{t-1}) / Assets_{t-1}.", "rationale": "Firms increasing R&D investment may have better growth prospects not yet fully priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Surge", "construction": "Percentage increase in short-term debt (Compustat: Data item 34) over the past fiscal year, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Large increases in short-term borrowing may signal impending liquidity needs or distressed financing, which could predict lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "One-year change in inventory turnover ratio: (COGS / Average Inventory)_{t} - (COGS / Average Inventory)_{t-1}.", "rationale": "Improving inventory turnover may indicate operational efficiency or increasing demand, both of which may predict higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Share Repurchase Ratio", "construction": "Net reduction in shares outstanding over the prior year divided by market capitalization at the start of the year.", "rationale": "Firms actively repurchasing shares may signal undervaluation or excess cash flow, leading to higher future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Holdings Change", "construction": "Annual change in percentage of shares held by insiders, based on SEC filings.", "rationale": "Increasing insider ownership may signal alignment with shareholders and private information about firm prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Unrecognized Loss Provision", "construction": "Change in allowance for doubtful accounts (Compustat: Data item 75) as a percent of accounts receivable.", "rationale": "An increasing allowance may indicate prudent risk management or anticipation of future losses that are not yet recognized by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Analyst Forecast Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of annual EPS forecasts from I/B/E/S, normalized by absolute mean forecast, at the fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Lower dispersion may indicate consensus and predictability, which can reduce risk premia and forecast higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Rate", "construction": "Annual number of patent citations (from USPTO data) per million dollars of total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing innovation output may enjoy future growth and profitability not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Gross Margin Stability", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly gross margin over the past three years.", "rationale": "Firms with more stable gross margins may have more predictable earnings, which may lower risk and result in higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Streak", "construction": "Number of consecutive quarters the firm has omitted its regular dividend, relative to its historical pattern.", "rationale": "Omission of dividends, especially by historically steady payers, may signal financial distress and predict lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
